turns.text: Hi, can you tell me when my order will arrive? It is still being made, I think.
Hello, I can help with that. To find your order, please send me the order number (it starts with SC- followed by four digits) and the email address you used when you placed the order.
The order is SC-3188 and the email is helen.crowe@example.com. It ships to Berlin.

Thank you, Helen. Your order SC-3188 (Blue Stair, 30x40 cm) is currently in production and ships to Berlin. Our system does not show an estimated arrival date yet, so I cannot give you one. Once the order has shipped, the tracking link will be on the order. Is there anything else I can check for you?
